title: Valuation probe from a specialization in the range
statement: Let j:Z\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let z\in Z and s\in S, and suppose j(z) specializes to s. Then there exist a valuation ring A with fraction field K, a morphism g:\operatorname{Spec}(A)\to S, and a morphism h:\operatorname{Spec}(K)\to Z such that g restricted to \operatorname{Spec}(K) equals h followed by j and the closed point of \operatorname{Spec}(A) maps to s.
